exercise.name: EX BOJRO AGHAT
exercise.unit: 17 Fd Regt Arty, 33 Arty Bde Gp

items.title: Parade State to Brigade
items.description: Forward Parade State to Bde in the prescribed format. COMPLAN due from Signal Bn around this time.
items.sourceRef: Gen Instr TF-A, para 7a; Officer Notebook Pt.2

items.title: Prep Training Programme Submitted
items.description: Submit unit's prep-training programme of events to Bde (GS Br).

items.title: Plan Presentation to Brigade
items.description: CO presents unit plan to Bde.

items.title: Location State, Helipad Info & Vehicle Plan
items.description: Forward final Location State, helipad information, and detailed vehicle plan to Bde (GS Br).

items.title: Recce Complete & Defence Layout Demo
items.description: Complete recce of own defence/target locations (min 8 km from IB). Forward umpire names to Sta HQ Cumilla. Attend Bn Defence Layout demonstration.
items.sourceRef: Gen Instr TF-A, para 4g(4); demo table

items.title: Dummy Targets Prepared & Red Vests Collected
items.description: Prepare dummy version of assigned targets. Collect red vests from TF-B HQ.
items.sourceRef: Gen Instr TF-A, para 4g(5); Dress table

items.title: Target Completion Report, Vest Distribution & Ambush Demo
items.description: Forward target completion report with photos. Distribute red vests to sub-units. Attend Ambush demonstration and Umpire Briefing. Be ready for TF-A Commander's target visit.
items.sourceRef: Gen Instr TF-A, para 4g(5); Officer Notebook Pt.2

items.title: Thunder Arresters in Possession
items.description: Every unit/location to be in possession of required thunder arresters.

items.title: Final Move Preparations
items.description: Vehicle loading complete, drivers rested and briefed with route cards, packet markings done, EME fitness forms held. Dry ration, POL, water tablets, anti-snake kits issued; ammo segregated.

items.title: Convoy Departure
items.description: Convoy departs training ground in packets per Move Plan. Movement intimated to Div Comd Voice before departure.
items.sourceRef: Admin Instr ST-2026, Anx A (Mov Plan)

items.title: Debus & Occupy Defence
items.description: Debus at designated points; occupy defence positions on foot following proper battle drill.

items.title: Deployment Complete (1800 hrs)
items.description: All elements of TF-A to be fully deployed by 1800 hrs.

items.title: Radio Communications Established
items.description: All wireless comms (HF to Bde, VHF internal) established by 061500 Jul.

items.title: Daily Routine Checks
items.description: Daily password promulgation; Rear OC reports at 0700/2000 hrs; sentries, thunder arresters and anti-snake trenches checked. (Applies throughout 05-14 Jul.)

items.title: Minor Ops & Target Depiction
items.description: Continuous: realistic target depiction, night recce/execution, every soldier completes min 1 minor op, all engagements covered by 2 umpires.
items.sourceRef: Gen Instr TF-A, para 3j-l, t, v

items.title: Return to Cantonment
items.description: Foot to embussing point, vehicle back to cantonment. Obtain NOC from local authority before leaving; settle crop compensation if applicable.
items.sourceRef: Admin Instr ST-2026, para 5g; Gen Instr TF-A, para 5a

items.title: After Action Review (AAR) Due
items.description: Forward AAR to Bde HQ per prescribed format (participation %, minor-op state, challenges, recommendations).
